messages:
maria: Heads-up — Q3 procurement planning: we need a short, concrete playbook for hybrid sourcing + backfill. goal is minimize SLA exposure during supplier lead delays. thinking: 1) staggered reserved buys, 2) vendor-diversity (2 vendors), 3) spot fallback policy + fast preemptible replacement. need buy-in from procurement and product by Fri.

ajay: +1. can you share expected demand curve? helps sizing reserved buys vs spot.

maria: posted rough numbers below. these are conservative: expected 120K token-reqs/s steady across the quarter, peak 210K during launches. required 99th latency SLO: 250ms for p99 small-model routes; dedicated GPU capacity target: ~220 cards equivalent.

linh: vendor timelines: vendor A: lead 14–18 weeks, vendor B: 10–12 weeks. both can do partial shipments. pricing delta ~8%. we can negotiate partial early shipment at ~+2% premium.

noah: product ask — which routes do we prioritize for reserved capacity? we need to lock top 3 routes to avoid regressions: chat-hosted, embed-batch, rerank-prod. if we only get 70% of requested cards, we should have explicit fallback maps to quantized variants.

sarah: Product agrees to prioritization above. also request a clear launch readiness checklist tied to capacity: "canary throughput verified at 60% peak traffic" and "automatic fallback enabled and smoke-tested".

maria: rough playbook draft (quick):
```
1) Commit 60% reserved capacity across two vendors (stagger invoices: week 0 and week 8)
2) Reserve 20% burst pool (short-term spot + reserved month-to-month) for launch weeks
3) Keep 20% as spot/backfill with automated requeue to fallback models
4) Maintain DR region capacity: 30% of dedicated cards in secondary region
5) SLAs: enforce fallback at 95th failure and notify owners via alerts channel
```

ajay: two operational concerns:
- prefix cache & batching: we need config tuning roadmaps to keep p99 latency within 250ms under mixed workloads
- KV cache warming plan for new cards (automated replay from s3 snapshot)

noah: For fallback models, here's the mapping we think is ok:
```
- chat-hosted -> chat-quant-v2
- embed-batch -> embed-int8
- rerank-prod -> rerank-2g-quant
```
we still need eval pass to confirm quality tradeoffs.

linh: procurement question — do we want to include an early-shipment clause for vendor B? it reduces lead by ~3 weeks but costs extra.

maria: yes include for vendor with fastest partials; cost delta is acceptable if it buys launch slack. put a cap: early ship budget <= 6% of quarter infra spend.

deploy-bot: Reminder: inventory-change request submitted for preliminary qty=150 cards. ETA vendor B partial: 11 weeks.

ajay: action items:
- linh: confirm vendor-diversity contract terms + early-ship cap (by Thu)
- noah/sarah: finalize priority routes + canary readiness checklist (by Thu)
- infra: write detailed KV cache warm/replay runbook and batching tuning plan (owner: ajay)

maria: i'll consolidate into short playbook doc and post in /docs/infra-q3-playbooks. please comment on the doc once posted. thanks :pray:

sarah: quick question — for billing/commits, is there an expected break in committed vs usage reporting? our finance partner needs that for forecasting.

linh: we'll provide a financial amortization sketch after contract terms. should be ready next Tue.

noah: curious — if spot fallback triggers, do we have clear customer-facing throttle behavior? we should avoid random 502s. prefer graceful degradation with rate-limited responses + consistent error shape.

ajay: agree. plan is: fallback model + rate-limiting at ingress + degraded response header "x-rw-fallback: true" so product can detect.

maria: thanks all. I'll send the doc link in this thread when ready. short sync Friday to sign off if needed. :calendar:
